title: Sources for a tableau step
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean input, and let $n,t\in\mathbb{N}$. The source list is formed by concatenating: $w$ copies of the constant-false tableau vertex if $t=0$, where $w$ is the snapshot width of $M$, and otherwise the tableau block for $M$ on input length $n$ at time $t-1$; three entries recording whether $t=0$, whether the input-head position at time $t$ lies between $1$ and $n$, and that position minus one when it does (or the constant-false vertex otherwise); the tape-source lists for each work tape; and, finally, the constant-false vertex if $t=0$, or the vertex at position $w$ in the tableau at time $t-1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean input
caveat: The supplied statement omits the definitions of the tableau block, tape sources, and tableau vertices, so their precise mathematical meanings cannot be stated self-containedly.
